name: Cyan Banister
description: Cyan is addicted to early stage angel investing. She spends a lot of her time dreaming about what the future could look like and invests in people who do the same but are creating it. Before Long Journey, she was at Founders Fund, a top tier fund in SF. Most of Cyan’s successful investments have a common theme around job creation and flexibility, but she has invested in everything from rocket ships to sandwich delivery. Cyan loves leaving space for adventure in her day and will make decisions with a roll of dice!

investment_theses.quote: I try to look six years out and think about what's coming next.
When I have high conviction, I'm in. That's what they [founders] want—someone to believe them. I'm comfortable with a company that doesn't have product market fit and hasn't figured it out yet.
It's whether they know something that nobody else seems to know. Do they have an insight or a moat or some sort of intelligence that they're onto something. ” S14
I'm always drawn to an inception story that starts from age seven. Because that means it's their life mission. I love entrepreneurs like this and I would back them all day long.
